annotations.title: Singapore public holidays and working days

description: Singapore public holidays and working days for 2026 and 2027 (MOM data, including observed Monday holidays). Pass date alone to ask whether it is a public holiday or working day; from + add to get the date N working days later (negative N for earlier); from + to to count working days between two dates; or year to list that year's holidays. Weekends and public holidays are skipped. Each answer has as_of and the official source. Example input: {"date":"2026-12-25"}.

add.description: Working days to add to date (negative to go back). The start date is not counted.

date.description: The day to check. On its own, the answer says whether it is a public holiday or a working day; with add or to, it is the start date for counting working days.

to.description: YYYY-MM-DD end date: count working days from date to this date.

year.description: 2026 or 2027: list that year's public holidays.
